productsAndServices.description: An online payment gateway for accepting card, digital wallet, and local payment-scheme transactions, with recurring payments, fraud controls, reporting, and e-commerce integrations.
productsAndServices.name: EdfaPay Payment Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A software point-of-sale service that enables NFC-enabled Android smartphones and tablets to accept contactless card and digital wallet payments without additional POS hardware.
productsAndServices.name: EdfaPay SoftPOS (Tap to Phone)

productsAndServices.description: An electronic invoicing service for creating, sending, and tracking branded invoices with embedded payment links, QR codes, multiple payment methods, and real-time status updates.
productsAndServices.name: EdfaPay E-Invoicing

productsAndServices.description: A payout and disbursement service for splitting and sending payments to multiple recipients, with automated processing, configurable fee profiles, bulk payments, and real-time tracking.
productsAndServices.name: EdfaPay Payout System

productsAndServices.description: Customizable payment infrastructure that banks, financial institutions, and payment partners can offer under their own brands, including gateway, SoftPOS, and related payment services.
productsAndServices.name: EdfaPay White-Label Payment Solutions

productsAndServices.description: RESTful APIs, software development kits, libraries, webhooks, and testing tools for integrating payment acceptance, SoftPOS, analytics, and other EdfaPay capabilities into applications and platforms.
productsAndServices.name: EdfaPay Payment APIs and SDKs

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,000,000, or 51.03% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,335,097 to $38,870,207, a 3.76x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 10 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
